protocol: Independent per-trajectory Umeyama Sim(3) translation ATE RMSE, all stride6+last support; equal-weight arithmetic mean over 11 sequences.
limitations: Fresh execution finished successfully but did not reproduce all target numerical results, even at two-decimal precision for the 22 VI scores.
Current repaired admission is an offline whole-sequence policy; this is not the original paper frozen configuration.
Known DPVO custom-kernel and native threaded execution nondeterminism prevents an exact-repeat guarantee. The contribution of each source to this run has not been isolated.
This validation used 3 GPUs and 8 native workers. The recommended serial native schedule was not the schedule tested in this complete run.
Native sources and matching precompiled binaries are included; clean recompilation of all native projects was not performed.
This QA folder is metadata and score evidence, not a runnable copy of the generated run. Predicted trajectories and datasets are intentionally excluded from the delivery.
Namespace-mount access audit is not syscall tracing; host Linux ABI and NVIDIA driver are still required.
